firstPlayerRule: Start with the player who has traveled furthest north. Turns continue clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: For solo play, arrange three heroes in a row and start with the leftmost hero. Take their turns from left to right, using the solo marker to track the active hero; all three share one hand of cards.
